html:
SMTO-MEM-0033 — That Knowledge item no longer exists

GUID: 4bd32f9b-6c27-5e8b-99ac-46776addbde1
Slug: knowledge-not-found
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • You picked a collection, document or indexing job that has been deleted or replaced, often in another tab or by someone else. The page was showing an old list.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you were typing a note or a collection name, copy that text somewhere safe first. Refreshing the list can clear what you typed.
  2. In Knowledge, select Refresh above the document list, or reload the page. This replaces the old list with the collections and documents that exist now.
  3. Choose the collection or conversation again and open the document you need from the new list. If it's gone, upload it again with Upload documents. A deleted or replaced item can't be opened; only items in the current list are available.

What success looks like

  • The item opens, or Preview shows the document's content.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, naming the item you tried to open. Don't delete other documents or collections to try to fix this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • RagStore.get found no Knowledge record (collection, document, job or document version) with the requested ID and kind, or the document preview targeted a document already marked deleted.

What this means

  • The collection, document or job selected by this request could not be found. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported not_found. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The selected Knowledge item opens.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Reload the list (GET /api/agent/rag/collections or the conversation's documents) and retry with a current ID; the record is absent from the rag_records store or the document has deleted=true. Nothing was changed by the failed request.
  • Refresh the collection or source list and select an existing item. Keep unsaved text before changing the selection.

Retry and execution caution

  • The selected Knowledge item opens.

How to verify the fix

  • The selected Knowledge item opens.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Searchable legacy references
